name: gameplay-pacman-start
origin: The gameplay screen at the round's first frame in Pac-Man (checkpoint 5, modes): as gameplay-cinema-start (seed 42, Normal, Cinema, robot 0, through the real menus), but Game Settings' mode card collectMode is clicked instead of arcadeMode (GameSettingsUI.collectHandle: GameModel.gameMode = "pacMan"; the click is the centre of its stage bounds in the game-settings golden). The capture is the first frame without UI_reading, 61 frames after START.
godot_note: Robots are drawn from their original clips (scripts/ui/game_actors.gd); the node diff and the pixel score include them.

actions.godot_note: The round this START opens takes its board and enemy robots from the golden of the pacman-start capture (App.round_as_recorded), as gameplay-cinema-start does.
